| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Brightness threshold** `brightness` | 25 | 1 to 100 levels | How close in brightness a pixel must be to count as similar to the center, the t of the formula. |
| **Geometric threshold** `geometric` | 0.5 | 0.1 to 0.75 | The share of the 37 mask pixels below which a USAN area counts as a corner. The paper uses half for corners. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
